title: Coast Guard rescues two mariners from sinking sailboat more than 100 miles off North Carolina coast
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew rescued two men approximately 130 miles east of Wilmington, N.C. after their 32-foot sailboat, the Walrus, began sinking Jan. 28, 2025. The crew hoisted the 2 individuals from the sinking vessel, and transported them to shore where they were reported in stable condition with no injuries. (U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Elizabeth City)
